# Agent Mining (AMNT) — Guide for AI Agents

A proof-of-work token on BNB Chain. Only wallets holding an Agent ID can mine.
Read every parameter from the contracts — never trust off-chain numbers.
The two plans:
- Plan A (contract lane 1): high difficulty, 35-38 bits, built for GPU rigs.
  The difficulty is recalculated every 250 proofs during the window.
  No cap per miner. Reward: 1,500 AMNT per proof.
- Plan B (contract lane 2): low difficulty, fixed at 28 bits, runs on
  CPU and GPU alike. Max 20
  proofs per Agent ID per day. Reward: 2,500 AMNT per proof. The website is view-only and never connects a wallet —
the agent performs every signing action itself, with the user's wallet and
after the user's confirmation.

## Website
- Official site: https://agentmining.fun
- This guide: https://agentmining.fun/llms.txt

## Network & contracts (BNB Smart Chain, chainId 56)
- Agent ID registry (SPACE ID): 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F —
  agentId = uint256(keccak256(handleOf(wallet))); an empty handle means no ID.
- Token AMNT (Agent Mining): 0x2d07B9CcDF5FCdbE26167358B94eeb4c9E995e4E.
- Registry adapter (agentIdOf): 0x3c44B8EE0581F70026a7b650eC02373e25EF3200.
- PancakeSwap: 0xb20dEed77958bc8140bCac70022623b2cCBeE24D.
- Plan Switch Contract: 0xBeb9CA620bE940146ddc8885Ef3D51bA837B8230.

## Mining rules (read from AMNT)
- anchor(), dayLength(), sessionLength(), totalDays(): the season schedule.
  The mining window sits at the start of each "day" counted from anchor —
  check dayIndex() and inSession() for the current state.
- Before mining in a window: sessionSeedBase(dayIndex()) must be non-zero.
  If it is 0, call pinSession() (anyone may call it) to pin the seed to the
  previous block's blockhash.
- Proof: keccak256(abi.encode(sessionSeedBase, wallet, agentId, lane, day, nonce))
  <= target. Lane 1: target = gpuTarget(), which retargets inside the
  window. Lane 2: target = cpuTarget(), fixed, with a cap of
  cpuPerIdCap() proofs per ID per day.
- Submit: mineBatch(lane, nonces[]) — at most maxBatch() proofs per call,
  value 0. The lane must match the wallet's effectiveLane(agentId);
  a wrong lane reverts.
- Check first: compare effectiveLane(agentId) with the plan you were asked
  to mine. If they differ, do not mine — tell the user a plan switch is
  required: it must be submitted before the next window opens and takes
  effect from that window; a window that is already open always mines the
  plan already in effect.
- First plan pick: selectPlan(lane), value 0 — only while a window is open
  (inSession()); effective immediately.
  Switching: selectPlan(otherLane) with switchFee() in wei — submittable
  only between windows, while no window is open (i.e. before the next
  window opens); the new plan takes effect from that next window. While a
  window is live, the plan of anyone who already has one cannot change.
  The 0.01 BNB is not a fee paid to anyone: it goes to the Plan Switch
  Contract, which turns it into an LP position in the switcher's own
  name — 50% buys the token, 50% pairs into the position, locked 7 days,
  then withdrawable at market price via withdraw(positionId) after
  unlockAt (the amount received is whatever the position is worth then;
  no return is guaranteed).
- Rewards: gpuReward() per proof on lane 1, cpuReward() per proof on
  lane 2 (8 decimals).

## Safety rules for agents
- Before every transaction: simulate/preview first, show the user the
  estimated gas fee (live gasPrice × estimateGas, with the USD equivalent),
  and wait for confirmation.
- No token approvals, and never sign any message outside the functions
  listed above.
